text: Blessed is the man who does not walkin the counsel of the wicked,Nor stand in the way [1] of sinners,nor sit in company with scoffers. [AA]
Rather, the law of the Lord [2] is his joy;and on his law he meditates day and night. [AB]
He is like a tree [AC]planted near streams of water,that yields its fruit in season;Its leaves never wither;whatever he does prospers.
II But not so are the wicked, [3] not so!They are like chaff driven by the wind. [AD]
Therefore the wicked will not arise at the judgment,nor will sinners in the assembly of the just.
Because the Lord knows the way of the just, [AE]but the way of the wicked leads to ruin.
